[[File:Red_10_Dies.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Rebel Alliance pilot Puck Naeco flew as Red Twelve]]
'''Red Twelve''' was the callsign of the twelfth member of [[Red Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons with this name, and several beings went by the name Red Twelve.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a pilot designated Red Twelve flew with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during a battle over [[Tythe/Legends|Tythe]].

During the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] pilot [[Puck Naeco/Legends|Puck Naeco]], flying as Red Twelve, covered [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]] on his failed [[Trench Run Defense|trench run]] alongside [[Red Ten/Legends|Red Ten]], [[Theron Nett/Legends|Theron Nett]]. He was killed when his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] fighter was destroyed by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Behind the scenes==
Red Twelve is not named in dialogue in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], but is mentioned in the script. The pilot's face is never seen, and the character was not named in any source for many years. It had been theorized that since the pilot in the scene depicting the death of [[Theron Nett/Legends|Theron Nett]] has a different helmet than Nett's, he may have originally been intended to be Red Twelve. ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' finally revealed pilot [[Puck Naeco/Legends|Puck Naeco]] flew as Red Twelve in the battle.

The unofficial fan-named character Drifter has been given the callsign Red Twelve by fans. It's been suggested that [[John Chapman|the actor]] is present in the award ceremony scene, and that he survived the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] assault, though Red Twelve clearly dies in the movie.
